title: ACT V
subtitle: The Sunken Reef
rewardRelicDesc: At the start of every battle your units gain +3 max HP.

intro.title: THE SUNKEN REEF
intro.text:
The shard hangs half-submerged — a lattice of coral, sunken ships, and old magic squeezed between two impossible tides.

Something large lives at its centre. Something old. The traders who escaped this shard don't talk about what they saw, but they all flinch at the same sounds: deep water, and bells.

intro.title: THE TIDAL SOVEREIGN
intro.text:
The Reef's guardian calls itself the Tidal Sovereign — a being of compressed sea-memory and slow, grinding patience.

It does not distinguish between invaders and travellers. The ocean, it once said, does not distinguish between ships it sinks and ships it simply forgets about.

You have decided not to be forgotten.

intro.title: THE PASSAGE
intro.text:
The ley lines that thread through the Sunken Reef are old — older than the Fracture, older than the Dominion. They connect, somewhere in the deep, to the Fractured Core.

If you can break through the Sovereign's grip on the pathways, you might finally understand what the Fracture Event actually was.

If. The word is doing significant structural work in that sentence.

outro.title: THE SOVEREIGN FALLS
outro.text:
The Tidal Sovereign does not collapse. It recedes — like a wave pulling back from shore, leaving behind silence and the smell of deep ocean.

The coral pathways glow. Sealed ley lines crack open. The Reef's memory of the Fracture is vivid and specific and terrifying, and you carry it with you as you leave.

outro.title: WHAT YOU LEARNED
outro.text:
The Fracture Event wasn't an accident.

Someone caused it deliberately. The Sovereign remembered the moment, the direction, the specific signature of the magic. A weapon that destroyed an empire by tearing the world apart at its seams.

You don't have a name yet. You have a direction.

outro.title: ONWARD
outro.text:
The Coral Mantle settles around you — a gift from the Reef, or a remnant of the Sovereign's dissolved form. Either way it fits.

Ahead: the Sky Dominion, where the aerial shards drift above clouds no map has ever charted. The ley lines point upward.

You have always been bad at taking hints.

coral-breach.label: Coral Breach
coral-breach.description: Reef defenders have blockaded the entry point. They don't ask questions first.

tidal-shrine.label: Tidal Shrine
tidal-shrine.description: An ancient stone altar sits at low tide, its carvings still sharp despite everything.

wreck-camp.label: Shipwreck Camp
wreck-camp.description: A dry pocket inside a sunken hull. Strange place to rest, but it'll do.

reef-bazaar.label: Reef Bazaar
reef-bazaar.description: A salvager deals in cards looted from sunken Dominion ships.

sunken-passage.label: Sunken Passage
sunken-passage.description: The only route through the reef's mid-section is heavily patrolled.

abyssal-ambush.label: Abyssal Ambush
abyssal-ambush.description: Something from deeper water has been watching you. It's done watching.

deep-current.label: Deep Current
deep-current.description: A ley-line current surfaces here — warm, electric, and full of lost things.

eventConfig.title: The Deep Current
eventConfig.description: A ley-line current surfaces from a crack in the reef floor. It carries the smell of the Fractured Core — sharp, electric, and ancient. Fragments of Dominion magic swirl in its flow.

pools.label: Reach in
pools.consequence: The current deposits a rare card in your hand

pools.label: Reach in
pools.consequence: The current pulls you briefly under — lose 12 HP

pools.label: Reach in
pools.consequence: Something warm and healing — restored 15 HP

pools.label: Reach in
pools.consequence: +25 crystals wash ashore

pools.label: Follow it downstream
pools.consequence: You find a Dominion salvage cache — +30 crystals

pools.label: Follow it downstream
pools.consequence: The current ends at a dead drop — uncommon card

pools.label: Follow it downstream
pools.consequence: The current fades before you reach anything

reef-patrol-elite.label: Reef Elite Guard
reef-patrol-elite.description: The Tidal Sovereign's personal patrol. They've been waiting for someone like you.

kelp-crossing.label: Kelp Crossing
kelp-crossing.description: Dense kelp forests slow movement and muffle sound. Something uses that to its advantage.

drowned-shrine.label: Drowned Archive
drowned-shrine.description: A Dominion library, somehow preserved. Its books are unreadable but its cards are intact.

eventConfig.title: The Drowned Archive
eventConfig.description: A Dominion archive sits perfectly preserved inside a sealed air pocket — marble shelves, brass fixtures, and a thousand books that have become coral. The card drawers, however, are watertight.

pools.label: Search the drawers
pools.consequence: A rare card, preserved in wax — yours

pools.label: Search the drawers
pools.consequence: Only common finds, but several — +20 crystals

pools.label: Search the drawers
pools.consequence: A pressure seal breaks — lose 8 HP

pools.label: Rest among the stacks
pools.consequence: Dry floor, still air — restored 15 HP

pools.label: Rest among the stacks
pools.consequence: A forgotten card falls from a shelf — uncommon

depth-rest.label: Thermal Vent
depth-rest.description: A warm geothermal vent. The heat is strange but it heals.

deep-elite.label: Leviathan Vanguard
deep-elite.description: A half-awake leviathan guards the approach to the Sovereign's sanctum.

tidal-sovereign.label: The Tidal Sovereign
tidal-sovereign.description: The Reef's ancient guardian. Patient, vast, and profoundly unimpressed by you.
bossDialogue: You carry the smell of land. We do not welcome that here.
The Fracture opened a wound in the sea's memory. You will not reopen it.
Every ship that entered uninvited is still here. At the bottom. Join them.

node-1776756542614.label: The Kelp Forest
node-1776756542614.description: So dense is the kelp, that you can’t see where you’ve been, or where to go…

node-1776756543230.label: Fluorescent Cavern
node-1776756543230.description: An underwater case that glows with algae, something moves ahead

node-1776756544027.label: Sand Flats
node-1776756544027.description: White sand so flat it feels impossible stirs in eddies of current.

node-1776756544618.label: The Wash
node-1776756544618.description: Water pulls your feet from under you, you struggle to steady yourself, and then you see something wrap around your leg…
